verdict: ROAS is under pressure; ad creative refresh is already in motion.
narrative: This period your Meta ads returned $5.09 for every $1 spent, but that figure has been declining — ROAS dropped roughly 52% week-over-week before showing early signs of stabilising in the most recent three days. Purchases have also pulled back from mid-October's pace of 3–4 per day, and Instagram reach fell 22% week-over-week, pointing to creative fatigue as the primary driver. Google Business Profile actions went quiet over the last few days of the window, which is a dip in local organic intent we're watching closely. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to arrest the efficiency decline, and spend is being held steady while new material is tested.

watch_item.issue: ROAS has fallen sharply week-over-week and purchase volume remains below October's baseline, with declining Instagram reach pointing to creative fatigue.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed this week; performance will be monitored daily to confirm the new material stabilises efficiency before spend is increased.
